model: RIB[*]24B-BCAI BACnet relay with analog input
applies_to: Functional Devices RIB[*]24B-BCAI BACnet MS/TP relay with one analog input and two binary inputs.
summary: A small BACnet MS/TP relay module: one relay output (BO1), two binary inputs and one analog input that can be set for 0-5 V, 0-10 V or a 10K thermistor. Three BVs and two AVs run an optional on-board set point function on the analog input.
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, BO1...).
BO1 has a 16-level priority array, minimum on/off times and a writable relinquish default.
AI1 units are writable (any BACnet unit) and the input type is set through Device_Type.

source.title: BACnet RIB Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement, RIB[*]24B-BCAI PICS v1.50

integration.summary: Command the relay through BO1 and read the inputs. Leave BV1 off unless you want the module to switch BO1 itself from AI1 against AV1/AV2.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DE277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; baud rates are listed in the PICS. Max_Master defaults to 127.
gotchas: BV3 reports whether the set point settings are valid before the set point function will act.
